{{Quote|Protas, meet us in battle. Through our sheer numbers, we will overcome you.|The kikla bid their challenge, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
According to [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod|legend]], the '''kikla''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of tiny [[Water/Legends|water]] dwellers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. They swarmed together to challenge the significantly larger [[Deity/Legends|god-beast]] [[Protas]] for rule over the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Kamino. The kikla met Protas at the [[Ancient Trench]] and [[Battle of the Ancient Trench|fought]] the [[Magic/Legends|mystical]] being for a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], but they were unable to defeat the god-beast, who ate the last kikla when the new [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was in the sky. Despite his victory, Protas was eventually defeated by a [[Unidentified aiwha pod|pod]] of [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]].

==Biology and appearance==
The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] legend "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]" told of the tiny kikla, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Water/Legends|water]]-dwelling [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the<ref name="tale" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kamino">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The kikla were armed with tiny [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="tale" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Protas continued to rule the oceans. He was next challenged by a sentient group of kikla swimmers. The kikla were tiny, but they were legion, and they challenged him [&hellip;]|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
Although diminutive, the kikla were legion and valued the title and honor of being the most powerful in the ocean. As such, they challenged the significantly larger [[Deity/Legends|monster-god]] [[Protas]] for supremacy, believing they would overpower him with their large numbers. However, the kikla were prone to infighting, even in the midst of [[Battle of the Ancient Trench|battle]] against Protas.<ref name="tale" />

==History==
{{Quote|Protas met the vast swarm of kikla in the deepest waters of the Ancient Trench, and there they fought.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
In "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod," a Kaminoan legend about the [[Cetacean/Legends|cetacean]] [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] and translated by [[Ryan Kaufman]], the kikla assembled a vast swarm to challenge the [[Magic/Legends|mystical]] Protas for rule of the oceans of Kamino. The kikla swarm met Protas in the deepest waters of the [[Ancient Trench]] and fought the god-beast for a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. They hoped to overwhelm and outlast Protas with their sheer numbers, but the kikla quarreled amongst themselves and fought inconsistently, inflicting only small wounds with their tiny teeth. The single-minded Protas maintained his strength through the prolonged battle, scattering the kikla school and slowly eating them. Finally, at the rise of the new [[Moon/Legends|moon]], the god-beast devoured the last of the kikla. Yet despite his victory, Protas was eventually defeated by a [[Unidentified aiwha pod|pod]] of [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]].<ref name="tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
The kikla were featured in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[List of short stories|short story]] "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' in [[2005]].<ref name="tale" />
